title: Bulk discount not applied when buying exactly 10
report: A customer bought exactly 10 gel pens for their office. Our site banner says 'Buy 10 or more, save 10%' but their receipt shows no bulk savings. They were charged the full price. A second customer with 12 pens got the discount fine.
